limitations.description: Many statistics in the report are explicitly marked as 'early findings' from the forthcoming 2026 consumer-trends study, which means the underlying survey data and analyses are preliminary and could change in the final publication .
limitations.mitigation: Treat figures as directional only and update analyses once the finalized dataset is released.

limitations.description: Numerous insights are derived from self-reported consumer surveys; such data are subject to response and social-desirability bias and may not accurately reflect real-world purchase behaviour.
limitations.mitigation: Supplement survey results with observed transactional or behavioural datasets wherever possible.

limitations.description: The report projects future retail and technology adoption trends out to 2026 and beyond, introducing forecasting uncertainty that can be affected by macro-economic, technological, or regulatory shifts .
limitations.mitigation: Stress-test key conclusions under alternative economic and adoption scenarios.

limitations.description: Details on geographic coverage, sampling frame, and weighting methodology are not disclosed, limiting the ability to assess the representativeness of the findings.
limitations.mitigation: Request full methodological appendix (country splits, sample sizes, weighting scheme) before generalising insights to broader populations.
